name: rest-quarter
description: A quarter-note rest with a complete zigzag and curved lower tail.
useCase: Insert a quarter-note rest in a musical score editor.
misuse: Use pause for pausing media playback.

16.reason: The full zigzag ends in a curved tail, keeping the rest distinct from a lightning mark.

24.reason: The larger rest retains its complete zigzag and open curved tail.
